verdict.rationale: Foreloop exposes structured CLI commands, GitHub comment triggers like '@foreloop retest' and '@foreloop link YOUR-REF', and an MCP interface letting agents 'read and update Foreloop' — these support agentic/automated operation but are not natural-language command parsing per se. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of free-form natural-language command input/parsing, examples of conversational commands being interpreted, and independent evidence of NL command usage in practice. [2026-09-24 adversarial bias audit (depth-spike lane): flip none -> partial KEPT (concrete documented command syntax: "@foreloop retest", "@foreloop link REF") but quality capped 5 -> 4 under the claimed-docs-only ceiling. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
